objectives.basis: Technical proposal for owner review; synthetic 53-byte evidence cannot size a production SLA

schedule.capture: Daily 02:00 after approved consistent snapshot/quiescence barrier
schedule.restoreDrill: Monthly and after material recovery-contract changes

backupContract.cipher: Existing CLINIA-RECOVERY-AES256GCM-V1 codec; authenticate before parse
backupContract.consistency: Snapshot identity plus exact per-table and per-object proof; capture times and writer boundary required
backupContract.rotation: New key per new capture; retain each old key while any corresponding archive is retained
backupContract.alerts: Decision file only. Owner must approve destination and acknowledge before monitor activation

recoveryContract.targetReconciliation: Before commit compare complete catalog and rows; after indeterminate commit stop and reconcile read-only; after sequences/bytes failure use another NEW target
